sources.name: Trading Card Dex
sources.description: Set pages enumerate English Weiss base cards and parallel printings (SR/SP/SSP/SEC+, promos, etc.). Detail slugs provide card preview images.

sources.name: Weiss Schwarz official / ENG DB mirror
sources.description: Community-maintained mirror of official English Bushiroad card metadata and official image URLs for base printings.

sources.name: TCG API / TCGPlayer
sources.description: Daily Weiss TCGPlayer market prices and changes. Enrichment requires an API key and is kept separate from catalog identity.

sources.name: TCGRate / TCGPlayer
sources.description: Useful browser-facing Weiss market/history reference; GitHub Actions access is blocked, so it is not a required automation dependency.

sources.name: TCG Republic
sources.description: Optional store-ask and image reference. Store asks are never treated as market prices.

sources.name: Palworld Official Card Game
sources.description: Official Palworld card list used to validate identity, rarity and release information.

model: Observed market, store ask, catalog identity and model outputs are distinct fields. A missing market price remains missing rather than being imputed from a store ask.
